biological_scope.excluded: bird interactions and published bird bi-period representation
biological_scope.reason: The insect protocol is source-defined at 60 min per site per monthly Period and has matching independent floral opportunity at the same scale.

network_unit.why_not_published_bimonthly: Bi-monthly groups are an author-derived analysis grouping. The raw source-native insect and floral protocols are monthly, Period maps one-to-one to month, all 120 Site x Period contexts are represented in both sources, and v9 permits empty or sparse local contexts without pooling them away.

identity_rules.plant_identity: Use source Plant_Best_ID exactly after trimming whitespace; missing sentinels are not taxa and no post-outcome taxonomic harmonization is allowed.
identity_rules.insect_identity: Use source Insect_Best_ID exactly after trimming whitespace; missing sentinels are not taxa and no post-outcome taxonomic harmonization is allowed.
identity_rules.interaction_row_validity: An interaction event exists only when both Plant_Best_ID and Insect_Best_ID are nonmissing.
identity_rules.blank_both_rows: The 821 rows with both Best_ID fields missing are source sampling subsections with no interaction, as explicitly described in the author R code. They create no taxon, pair, or weight but preserve evidence that the Site x Period context was sampled.
identity_rules.one_sided_identity_rows: The structural audit found zero plant-only and zero insect-only Best_ID rows. If this changes under source drift, fail closed before targets.

interaction_weight.rule: Each valid identified interaction row contributes weight 1. Sum rows for duplicate Plant_Best_ID x Insect_Best_ID pairs within each Site x Period.
interaction_weight.num_sp_rule: Do not use Num_sp as interaction weight. It is a positive integer field on identified rows but the audited author R scripts never reference Num_sp when reconstructing networks; they retain Period, Site, Insect_Best_ID and Plant_Best_ID and use table(Plant_Best_ID, Insect_Best_ID), which counts rows.

author_r_evidence.network_construction: table(Plant_Best_ID, Insect_Best_ID) after removing rows where both IDs are missing

local_plant_resource_opportunity.rule: A plant is locally available in a Site x Period iff an identified Plant_Best_ID row is present in Floral_abundance for that context with a positive numeric Nb_Floral_unit.
local_plant_resource_opportunity.source_structure: All 8532 identified floral rows have positive numeric Nb_Floral_unit. The remaining 14 rows use literal NA for Plant_Best_ID, Name_Floral_unit and Nb_Floral_unit and are empty-quadrat placeholders, not plant identities.
local_plant_resource_opportunity.secondary_resource_measure: Summed Nb_Floral_unit by Plant_Best_ID x Site x Period may be retained as a descriptive secondary resource-abundance field, but it is not used to tune v9 or change the primary availability definition.

observation_exposure.primary_rule: Fixed 60 minutes per Site x Period according to the published/source protocol.
observation_exposure.h_start_h_end_rule: H_start and H_end are event/provenance timing fields only and must not be summed into sampling effort because event-row intervals overlap and do not represent additive observation windows.
observation_exposure.standardization_consequence: No fitted detection/effort layer is required for the primary Martinique comparison because the insect observation protocol is fixed across all 120 contexts.

hard_boundaries: Do not merge P1-P12 into six bi-monthly networks for the primary v9 validation.
Do not drop Site x Period contexts because they are sparse or contain zero valid interaction events.
Do not treat literal NA placeholders as taxa or floral opportunity.
Do not use Num_sp as interaction multiplicity.
Do not sum H_start/H_end intervals as effort.
Do not infer plant opportunity from visited plants; use the independent Floral_abundance sheet.
Do not calculate pair-support fraction, turnover, Shannon diversity, empirical ranges, or v9 predictive envelopes until this reconstruction contract passes CI.
Do not retune v9 support or weight strengths using Martinique.
